name: Operational efficiency

subjectOf.text: Larger managers will be incentivized to begin the innovation process if and when they realize that smaller competitors using these technologies gain substantial operational efficiencies and cost savings.
subjectOf.abstract: This, however, may change in the foreseeable future if and when larger managers realize that their smaller competitors who utilize these technologies gain substantial operational efficiencies and cost savings
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Applications and Fee Structure Developments in Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2959730
scope_conditions: competitive pressure from smaller technology adopting managers

subjectOf.text: Per transaction fee models were previously impractical because settlement and calculation created a prohibitive amount of manual work; blockchain removes that barrier by automatically allocating the correct fee to the correct executed trade and client account without manual reconciliation.
subjectOf.abstract: It enables the fully automated allocation of the appropriate fee to the correct executed trade and associated client account without any manual reconciliation or settlement.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033
